_comment: App Store の英語（en-US）の説明文など。上限: name 30 字 / subtitle 30 字 / description 4000 字 / keywords 合計 100 字（カンマ込み）/ promotionalText 170 字。
name（名前）と subtitle（サブタイトル）は App 情報の項目で、ほかの項目とは別に App 情報の言語に書き込む。省略すると App Store Connect 側の値をそのまま残す。
アプリ名とカテゴリ名はもともと検索対象なので keywords に入れなくてよい。「Discord」は現行のキーワードでも審査を通っているので入れている。
promotionalText は省略できる（省略すると App Store Connect 側の値をそのまま残す）。
whatsNew は「このバージョンの最新情報」（上限 4000 字）。version が反映先のバージョンと一致するときだけ書き込む。リリースごとに version と text を書き換える。
name: Ninja Cord
subtitle: Anonymous SNS Posting App
promotionalText: Post to your Discord channels via webhook with any name and avatar. Live embed preview, templates and broadcasts make announcements and alerts effortless.

whatsNew.text:
■ See how it looks on Discord before you send
• "How it looks on Discord" now stays at the top of the Send screen, so you can check the name, avatar, message, embed and attached image as you type
• If you leave the name or avatar blank, the preview shows the webhook's own name or avatar for that item once it loads

■ A clearer Send screen
• Fields are now grouped into Destination, Sender, Message, Embed and Attachment sections, and you can collapse Sender
• New field icons show which part of a Discord message each field fills in

■ Sending improvements
• Send an embed or image without any message text — even an image on its own
• Leave the name blank to post with the name set on the Discord webhook
• If the message is empty and the app's default text would be sent, you'll be asked to confirm first. Turn this off with "Confirm Before Sending Defaults" in Settings

■ Automatic theme
• The app's colors can now switch automatically to match your device's Light or Dark appearance. Choose Automatic under Theme in Settings
• Pick a theme at the end of the getting-started guide

description:
Ninja Cord sends messages to Discord through webhooks. No bot to build and no server to run — just paste a webhook URL and post to a channel with any name and avatar you like.

■ Send in seconds
• Pick the sender name, avatar and message
• Add an embed with a title and description, and see how it will look in Discord with a live preview
• Attach one image (up to 10 MB)

■ Built for repeat use
• Save webhook URLs with a name and switch between them in one tap
• Save messages you send often as templates, then pin and reorder them
• Check what went through in the send history (stored only on this device, and you can turn it off)
• Light, dark and automatic themes (automatic follows your device's appearance)

■ Ninja Cord Pro (monthly auto-renewing subscription)
• No ads
• Unlimited templates (the free plan keeps up to 3)
• Embed color, fields, image, thumbnail, footer and timestamp
• Broadcast the same message to several saved destinations at once
Watch an ad to try full embeds and broadcasting for one send (ad removal and unlimited templates are not included).

■ Getting started
1. In Discord, open Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks for the channel you want to post to
2. Create a new webhook and tap Copy Webhook URL
3. Paste it into the URL field in Ninja Cord and send
You need the Manage Webhooks permission on that server to create a webhook.

■ Please note
• Anyone who knows a webhook URL can post to that channel. Keep your URLs private.
• Ninja Cord is not an official Discord app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord Inc.
